_doc: MANABIT autonomous loop backlog. Protocol: design/process/autonomous-loop.md. The loop PICKS the highest `priority` item whose `gate` is `loop`. Items gated `owner` are never picked - they are mirrored into loop/owner-queue.md and wait. Rescore after every iteration.

_scoring.lift: 1-5, expected enjoyment gain. 5 = moves 3+ personas or repairs a headline promise.
_scoring.evidence: 0-3. 3 = a number from a committed artifact (tools/sim/out/*, a seeded probe). 2 = observed directly (rendered frame, live probe) but not root-caused. 1 = reasoned from the design. 0 = taste alone.
_scoring.risk: 1-5 blast radius. 5 = frozen section 13 contract, save schema, or a final taste call -> AUTO-ESCALATE, never picked.
_scoring.law: An item with evidence < 2 may not be built. It may only be MEASURED - build the instrument first, then rescore. This is the rule that stopped wave 1 shipping two wrong-way changes on vibes.

items.title: New-player legibility: fragility + overweight nudge, and an honest 'defanged' loss reason
items.why: R3 / D3. outcome() returns SURVIVABLE_LOSS the moment has_offensive_move() is false (combat.gd:172), but is_deployable() needs only ONE offensive bit. A deploy-legal core+1-arm build passes the Workshop gate then loses on turn 1 before the player acts. Novice own-build ventures lose 58.3% of the pos0 Rusty skirmish. The loss screen says nothing about why.
items.criterion: PRE-STATE before building: a one-offensive-bit build shows a build-time fragility warning in the BalanceMeter, and the defang loss path prints a distinct reason string. Verified in a rendered frame (L3) plus a smoke_layout/smoke_builder assertion. No change to combat.gd resolution.
items.touches: ui/workshop.gd, ui/combat_screen.gd copy, BalanceMeter. Frozen surfaces: none.

items.title: Junction lane labels tell the truth about risk
items.why: R7 / D8. Measured per-mod outcomes: overgrown ('the foe fields heavier bits') is the SAFEST lane at DEATH 0.00, tailwind ('mended 4 HP', sounds like a gift) is the DEADLIEST at DEATH 0.59. The menace label is the safe pick. This directly violates the project's own standing law that card text IS the rule and the FTL lying-label anti-pattern is banned.
items.persona: QA Hunter + Optimizer (decision depth: a choice you cannot read is not a choice)
items.criterion: PRE-STATE: per-lane DEATH rate ordering matches the ordering a player would infer from the printed card text, measured on the existing sessions aggregate. Elite fork only - the BOSS fork rusted lane is already correctly the harder pick and must stay.
items.touches: meta/run_mods.gd card text, ui route cards. Frozen surfaces: none - modifier RULES unchanged, only the copy.

items.title: Restore elite core-hunt stakes (Pindrop structural, Sable undertuned)
items.why: R1 / D1. Two of six 'core-hunting' elites have a 0% DEATH rate. Pindrop is STRUCTURAL: its loadout is HEAD MULTI / ARM_L GUARD / ARM_R MULTI / BACK MULTI, zero SINGLE moves, and the core-hunt branch (combat.gd:146-152) only fires for archetype==SINGLE, so it can never land a killing blow (0/60). Sable has 2 SINGLE moves but is too weak (0/60). Cogsworth 30/60, Brassmore 49/60 confirm the probe is sound. The panel calls this the single highest-leverage change.
items.persona: QA Hunter + Cozy Collector + the difficulty curve (3 lenses at once)
items.criterion: PRE-STATE: Pindrop and Sable each reach a DEATH rate inside the elite band set by Cogsworth (30/60) and Thornlash (24/60) - NOT above Brassmore. Re-measure with tools/sim/qa_verify.gd. CH-05/CH-06 were reverted once on wrong-way criteria; re-apply only with the band stated first and revert again if it moves wrong.
items.touches: Challenger loadouts and move powers only. Frozen surfaces: combat.gd resolution and base fixtures are OFF LIMITS.

items.title: The modal first Box of Scrap should not be a guaranteed death
items.why: R3 / D2. Kit survival by grade is a step function: Dud/Rough/Fair all ~0.00 at every skill tier, Keen 0.86-1.00, Gleaming 1.00. Fair is the 32% modal roll, so P(survive first box) ~= 0.25 and the median FIRST free kit dies 100% at the boss regardless of play. Real stakes are intended; a guaranteed-loss modal first experience is a new-player cliff.
items.criterion: PRE-STATE: P(survive) for a player's first N boxes rises above a stated floor without flattening the Gleaming payoff. Options: a first-boxes pity floor, or a clearer grade-power read at crack time so a Fair box reads as a short outing rather than a run. Re-measure on smoke_kit_sim per-lane bands.
items.touches: economy/box_roller.gd odds or ui reveal copy. Frozen surfaces: none, but smoke_kit_sim is the tripwire.

items.title: Boss difficulty should rise, not fall (Gildfall folds, Brassmore is the wall)
items.why: R4 / D4. Under optimal aggression the ch8 FINALE Prince Gildfall is WIN 1.000 / DEATH 0.000 while the EARLIER ch4 Sunking Brassmore is WIN 0.305 / DEATH 0.695. The finale folds to the exact tech a player has already found by the earlier boss. The identical ~0.12 ladder win rates are a greedy-AI artifact hiding this.
items.criterion: PRE-STATE: measured WIN under the RACE policy is monotonically non-increasing across ch4 -> ch8. Fix by giving Gildfall real core defense (guard/mend when threatened) or by swapping boss order.
items.touches: Challenger loadouts / AI behaviour. Frozen surfaces: combat.gd resolution OFF LIMITS.

items.title: Rarity should not be an inverted value signal
items.why: R6 / D10. Mean win-rate deltas: EPIC arm_seer -0.0058 and EPIC pocketful_arm_grinlet -0.1225 are NEGATIVE, while COMMON grumble_co_girder_fist +0.191 and COMMON errant_core_pledge +0.165 are among the strongest. Grinlet at -0.1225 is a genuine dead bit. Players see rarity and raw stats and no counter-data. Rarity is not uniformly wrong (EPIC bedrock legs +0.34) - it is unreliable, which is worse than a known-flat signal.
items.persona: Optimizer + Cozy Collector (a chase item that makes you weaker poisons collection)
items.criterion: PRE-STATE: both negative EPICs land above a stated delta floor after repricing, measured on the roster sim, without pushing any bit past the existing band ceiling.
items.touches: parts/catalog_extra.json stats. Frozen surfaces: the 13 base fixtures are hardcoded and OFF LIMITS.

items.title: Coffer odds string reads as a typo: 'C70 R22 E8 %'
items.why: Observed in a rendered frame (loop/out/shots/shot_coffer_nook.png, shot_barrow.png). The trailing bare '%' after the last number reads like a stray glyph rather than a unit applying to all three. Odds legibility is the honest-information promise of the Coffer Nook and it is the first number a new player is asked to trust.
items.criterion: PRE-STATE: the odds line reads unambiguously as three percentages in a rendered frame, at the same or smaller width (the 720px layout budget has zero slack - smoke_layout must stay green).
items.touches: ui coffer/broker copy. Frozen surfaces: none.

items.title: Audit the saturated cyan panel on the Brass Coffer lid against the warm palette
items.why: Observed in shot_coffer_nook.png: a bright saturated cyan rectangle sits on the coffer lid inside an otherwise warm brass/wood frame. It may be the intended Glimmer/mana tell, but at that saturation it reads as an untextured placeholder rather than etched-rune plastic with a soft mana glow. Needs a root-cause read against the art bible before it is called a defect.
items.criterion: MEASURE FIRST: identify the source material/token, compare against the DESIGN.md palette tokens, and either confirm it as intended (close the item) or reprice the colour. Do not repaint on taste alone.
items.touches: coffer face render / Tokens. Frozen surfaces: none.

items.title: Proving Grounds spoils lines name bits but never their value
items.why: R7 tail, corroborated in shot_proving.png: every challenger row lists 'Spoils: <bit names>' with no worth attached, while the wager loop asks the player to weigh a scrap stake against those spoils. The panel separately measured the loot gradient INVERTED (stake-10 Cogsworth loots a melt-45 EPIC; stake-20 Gildfall loots melt-20), so the reward does not track the difficulty and the screen gives the player nothing to notice that with.
items.persona: Optimizer + Newcomer (an informed wager needs both numbers)
items.criterion: PRE-STATE: a rendered frame shows spoils value alongside the stake on every challenger row, within the row height budget, smoke_layout green. Whether to also FIX the inverted gradient is a separate balance item.

items.title: INSTRUMENT: a decision-density probe for the build screen
items.why: The Optimizer scores 5/10 because 'the legal build collapses to one greedy answer identical across every core' and 'the soul pick is nearly cosmetic'. That is currently a reasoned claim, not a measured one - there is no instrument that counts how many distinct builds are within X% of optimal under the weight cap. Every other headline claim in the loop is numbers-grounded; this one is not, so under the evidence law it cannot be built against yet.
items.criterion: Build the probe FIRST: report the count of distinct near-optimal builds per core and the overlap between them. Then rescore L-10 into a real balance item with evidence 3.

items.title: Turn cap / wall-fight pacing (D13 ADR)
items.why: R2 / D7. combat.gd outcome() has no turn counter. 27.2% of damaging hits land for exactly 1 (the DEF floor at combat.gd:107). Cogsworth-mirror resolves at turn 167; GUARD-vs-Brassmore at 221. The ladder top is uncappable (reached_top 0.00 at every tier). Fights provably terminate, so this is a grind not a lock - but it is a 5-10 minute slog and it caps the ladder.
items.blocked_by: The resolver is section 13 frozen. A turn cap needs a tiebreak rule (core-HP %) and that is an owner ADR, not a loop edit.

items.title: Cozy endgame bundle: coffer RNG persistence, a Glimmer sink, a discovery faucet
items.why: R5 / D5+D6+D9. PlayerState._init always runs PackRoller.new(20260711) and SaveManager persists no roller or pity field, so every fresh boot replays a byte-identical brass stream and every new player cracks the identical 'surprises' - coffers are relaunch-scummable. Glimmer: 57.2 earned per player over 30 days, 0.0 spent on all 30. Compendium: only 12.6% reach 80% in a month. The panel estimates this moves the Cozy Collector from 6 to ~8.
items.blocked_by: Needs save schema v5. The workbench already lists D7/D9 as owner-gated save-v5 items.

items.title: Speed axis payoff (D11 ADR)
items.why: Measured dead: speed buys initiative and nothing else, the sniper attack rates sit at 0.00/0.00/0.03/0.00, and the whole silksteel core-sniper family beats nobody in the pentagon. An entire advertised build direction is inert.
items.blocked_by: Any real payoff changes resolution order or adds a resolver hook - section 13 territory. Already queued as an owner ADR in the workbench.

items.title: Wave 2 bit meshes (20 bits on procedural placeholders)
items.why: design/art/wave2-mesh-work-order.md is written and waiting. The catalog is 100 bits; 20 of them ship on procedural placeholders.
items.blocked_by: Needs the owner's Blender rig on the second PC. No amount of loop autonomy produces a hand-rigged mesh.
